title: 第10章 天大的权贵，妖兽后裔
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
住持便是道观之主，在大景朝内也可直接称之为道长。
成为龙起观的住持？
姜长生迟疑，没有立即回答，要说没想过，那是不可能的，他自认为实力已经是龙起观最强，没有人比他更有资格，只是他没有预料到这么快就要面临此事。
龙起观也不算什么权力机构，没有勾心斗角，弟子清心寡欲，道长自然没有必要试探弟子。
姜长生回答道：“为道观效力，我自然愿意，不过我还年少，恐不能担任，大师姐比我更适合，况且师父为何这样问，您还能继续当很多年啊。”
清虚道长抬起右手，袖口落下，露出满是黑色血管的手腕，好似被一条条黑虫爬满皮肤表面，还在蠕动，惊悚可怕。
姜长生皱眉。
清虚道长平静道：“此毒乃是魔门的至邪之毒，纵然是真龙之气也无法消除，为师最多活五年，再给你五年时间，你做好承担住持职责的准备，至于你大师姐，她是女流，容貌出众，又与秋河是亲兄妹，若为住持，必惹来灾祸。”
姜长生觉得在理，龙起观本身位于大景朝的权力中心，时常有达官贵人前来做客，一名貌美的住持确实会惹来许多麻烦。
五年……
五年之后，他出二十一岁，太早了吧！
姜长生虽然不拒绝当住持，但也不想太过早繁忙，他目前的主要精力想要用在修行之上。
“当真无药可救？”姜长生皱眉问道。
清虚道长摇头失笑道：“事无绝对，只是尚未有解药，长生，要引以为戒，少招惹魔门，无论是好是坏，逆天下大势者，总会为身边人带来厄运。”
姜长生追问道：“为何这么说，魔门有什么特殊来历？”
逆天下大势者……
不会是反贼吧！
清虚道长摇了摇头，不再多说。
姜长生犹豫片刻，继续问道：“师父，您可知我的身世？似乎有人想要杀我，之前的祸……”
“不必多想，与你无关，只是有人想除掉龙起观罢了。”清虚道长打断道。

姜长生再次皱眉。
好不容易有机会询问，他可不会放弃。
清虚道长与皇帝姜渊关系那么好，必须试探！
“陛下为何对我格外关照？我听陈礼说起过，仅凭一面之缘，他便想引荐我参加武科举，还让四皇子找我习武，上次陛下看我的眼神……”
姜长生没有往下说，因为清虚道长正紧紧盯着他，那眼神格外的陌生，他从未见过清虚道长露出过这般眼神。
刹那间，姜长生已经做好战斗的准备。
他敢问，底气就是来自于实力！
倘若清虚道长救他，也是阴谋的一环，大不了他先逃出京城，来日无敌时再杀回来。
清虚道长幽幽道：“长生，我不知你所学源自于谁，想必背后定然有高人指点，连为师都无法察觉到的高人，其功力难以想象，怕是灵识境之上的盖世高人，但为师劝你小心，勿要轻信他人，没错，你的身世确实不简单，这里面的不简单不值得你去探索，很危险，也很残酷。”
闻言，姜长生皱眉，他没有反驳清虚道长，虚构靠山也没什么，但清虚道长的话让他想到更多的可能。
“为师今日就告诉你当今武道之境界，由低到高往上依次为三流、二流、一流、真元、灵识，灵识境在寻常江湖内被称为绝顶高手，但事实并非如此，上面还有更高的境界，为师目前知道的便有通天之境，当今陛下看似没有功力，可他身怀天子气运，一旦施展真龙之气，可比灵识境高手，最重要的是皇宫里有一位通天境强者，那人是大景朝真正的支柱。”
清虚道长的语气高深莫测，听不出他的情绪。
三流、二流、一流、真元、灵识、通天！
姜长生的眉头皱得更紧，鬼目邪王乃是灵识境高手，突破至道法自然功第四层前他便能轻松击杀鬼目邪王，说明那时他至少相当于灵识境无敌的实力，现在远超当时，他应该能跟通天境强者比。
这只是他的猜测，他不敢赌，他只能活一世，无转生机会，必须小心翼翼。
清虚道长再次开口道：“为师救你，已然为龙起观惹来天大的祸端，本想隐瞒下去，但你已有探查之心，为师只能告诉你，长生，你的生路只有两条，一是为师送你去江湖上的圣地，但仍逃不过仇敌的追杀，二是我再庇护你五年，五年内，你尽可能的成长，之后借着龙起观之名，拉拢自己的人脉，抗衡那天大的权贵，龙起观的存在乃是皇帝陛下当年立国、昭告天下时所立，除非龙起观谋逆，否则连陛下都不得拔掉龙起观。”
“大景，以信义为国本，上至天子，下至百姓，信义最重要。”
“好了，你退下吧。”
姜长生这一次没有再追问，拱手行礼转身离去。
转身之后，他的脸色变得冰冷。

天大的权贵。
姜长生已经听懂了清虚道长的言外之意，同时感到庆幸与后怕，幸好自己见到姜渊时没有鲁莽。
幽静的小院里，清虚道长盯着面前的老树，那一片斑驳的秋叶缓缓落下，落在下方的草堆上，没有激起半点尘埃，悄无声息。
“唉，家国难双全……”
与清虚道长聊完后的第二日，姜长生搬出来，单独找了一间庭院住下，身为二师兄，他自然有这个资格，主掌大权的孟秋霜甚至都没有多问一句，直接同意。
青苦倒是很舍不得，不过姜长生同意他以后随时来拜访自己，这小子方才露出笑容。
之所以单独住，姜长生是不想被打扰，安心练功。
皇宫里的通天境强者已经成为他的假想敌，他必须尽可能的变强。
关于清虚道长所中之毒，他也会想办法试试能否解毒，毕竟他已经掌握春秋医典，只是暂时不能解毒，先等一两年，倘若这两年没有遇到危险，那说明清虚道长是真的对他好。
姜长生的搬离并没有引起弟子们的诧异，反而觉得理所应当，他早就该搬出去。
二师兄住他们院子里，让他们平时难免有些局促。
单独住后，姜长生连钟都不敲了，将该责任转交给其他弟子，他现在是二师兄，除了孟秋霜，自然没有人敢拒绝他。
一晃眼。
大雪终至，寒雪覆盖京城。
“正魔两道齐聚会阳山，正欲来一场盖世大战，怎料会阳山内走出一人，自称阳昭帝，一身功力可怕至极，正魔两道联手，都被他一人打下山去，名震天下。”
“虽是江湖，但怎能称帝？陛下得知后勃然大怒，下令银甲豹轻骑前去围剿会阳山，三千银甲豹轻骑啊，那可是大景朝的精锐，死伤过千，阳昭帝还逃了，如今阳昭帝的悬赏挂遍景朝天下的各个角落。”
陈礼抑扬顿挫的说着，手里握着酒杯，好似那说书人，姜长生听得津津有味。
新的一年，陈礼老得比时间还快，鬓上的花白越来越多，眉眼间尽是疲惫之色。
每次来龙起观，陈礼除了带礼物，都会跟杨岱说说江湖上、朝堂上的那些事，有时也会解着由头抒发自己的烦闷。
姜长生听完江湖上的风云人物后，好奇问道：“陛下仍醉心丹道吗？”

陈礼一听，愤慨道：“没错，简直昏庸！”
姜长生被吓到，虽然他的感官出众，知晓楼房外没有人，但陈礼的大胆可不是好事，容易引来杀身之祸，他可不想过上颠沛流离的生活。
“不得胡言，陈大哥，平时还是要多注意言行啊，或许你的困境就与你的言行相关。”
姜长生语重心长道，陈礼的酒劲顿时醒了一些，但仍很愤怒。
陈礼咬着牙道：“陛下重用妖道，妖道与二皇子走得近，迟早会生夺嫡之危，到时候……”
姜长生一听，琢磨出味道来。
假太子的位置不稳啊。
妖道与二皇子走得近，会不会就是姜渊的意思？
陈礼端起酒杯，一口闷下，擦了擦嘴，长吐一口浊气，道：“长生，我先走了，那小箱子里是一颗蛇蛋，此蛇蛋乃是一条妖蛇所生，极具灵性，若是能养好，世世代代传承下去，以后可成护山灵兽。”
他起身披上蓑衣，提剑离去。
望着他弯曲的背影，姜长生心中不忍，开口道：“陈大哥，若是遇到麻烦，可与我说，我能帮则帮。”
陈礼停在房门口，轻笑道：“臭小子，真需要你帮忙的时候，我陈家必然已经走上末路，那时我不会吝啬开口的，好好修炼吧。”
他推门而出，将房门轻轻关上。
姜长生沉默，看来这京城的漩涡是越来越乱了。
皇帝沉迷追求长生，在前世华夏历史里，都是不好的开端，甚至可能迎来王朝崩溃。
大景朝不会是异界的秦朝吧！
姜长生起身来到桌前，将小箱子上的布掀开，热，他甚至能感受到里面淡淡的灵力。
妖兽后裔吗？
姜长生产生兴趣，养养宠物也不错嘛。
从他目前的了解来看，这世上虽有妖物，但很少，至少还不足以颠覆人族王朝，这天下更没有仙神的存在，至于修仙者，大多都是蛊惑人心的妖道、江湖骗子，经常被武者逼出原形，丑态尽出。
content_en:
The abbot is the master of the Taoist temple, and can also be directly called the Taoist priest in the Dajing Dynasty.
Become the abbot of Longqi Temple?
Jiang Changsheng hesitated and did not answer immediately. It was impossible to say that he had not thought about it. He believed that he was already the strongest in Long Qiguan and no one was more qualified than him. However, he did not expect to face this matter so soon.
Long Qiguan is not a power organization, there is no intrigue, and the disciples are pure-hearted, so the Taoist priest naturally has no need to test the disciples.
Jiang Changsheng replied: "Of course I am willing to work for the Taoist temple, but I am still young and may not be able to take the position. The senior sister is more suitable than me. Besides, why does the master ask this? You can continue to be one for many years."
Taoist Priest Qingxu raised his right hand and dropped his cuff, revealing his wrist covered in black blood vessels. It was as if black worms were crawling all over the skin and were still squirming. It was horrifying and scary.
Jiang Changsheng frowned.
Taoist Master Qingxu said calmly: "This poison is the most evil poison of the Demon Sect. Even the aura of a true dragon cannot eliminate it. You can live up to five years as a master. I will give you another five years to be ready to take on the responsibilities of the abbot. As for your senior sister, she is a female with outstanding appearance. She is also a brother and sister to Qiu He. If she becomes the abbot, she will definitely cause disaster."
Jiang Changsheng thought it was reasonable. Longqiguan itself was located at the center of power of the Great Jing Dynasty, and dignitaries often came to visit. A beautiful abbot would indeed cause a lot of trouble.
Five years...
Five years later, he turned twenty-one. It was too early!
Although Jiang Changsheng does not refuse to be the abbot, he does not want to be too busy too early. His main energy currently wants to be spent on cultivation.
"Is there really no cure?" Jiang Changsheng asked with a frown.
Taoist Master Qingxu shook his head and said with a smile: "There are no absolutes, but there is no antidote yet. To live forever, you must take a warning and avoid provoking the devil. No matter whether it is good or bad, those who go against the general trend of the world will always bring misfortune to those around them."
Jiang Changsheng asked: "Why do you say that? What is the special origin of the Demon Sect?"
Those who go against the general trend of the world...
He can't be a rebel!
Taoist Priest Qingxu shook his head and said no more.
Jiang Changsheng hesitated for a moment and continued to ask: "Master, do you know my life experience? It seems that someone wants to kill me. What happened before..."
"Don't think too much, it has nothing to do with you, it's just that someone wants to get rid of Long Qiguan." Taoist Master Qingxu interrupted.
Jiang Changsheng frowned again.
When he finally got the chance to ask, he wouldn't give up.
Taoist Priest Qingxu has such a good relationship with Emperor Jiang Yuan that he must be tested!
"Why does Your Majesty pay special attention to me? I heard Chen Li say that just because of a casual relationship, he wanted to recommend me to participate in the martial arts examination, and also asked the fourth prince to find me to practice martial arts. The way His Majesty looked at me last time..."
Jiang Changsheng did not say anything further, because Taoist Qingxu was staring at him closely, his eyes were particularly unfamiliar. He had never seen Taoist Qingxu look like this before.
In an instant, Jiang Changsheng was ready to fight.
He dared to ask, confidence comes from strength!
If Taoist Master Qingxu saves him, it is also part of the conspiracy. At worst, he will escape from the capital first and then come back when he is invincible.
Taoist Master Qingxu said quietly: "Changsheng, I don't know who you are learning from. There must be an expert behind you. Even the master cannot detect it. His skill is unimaginable. I am afraid he is an unparalleled master above the realm of spiritual consciousness. However, I advise you to be careful and don't trust others. Yes, your life experience is indeed not simple. The simplicity in it is not worthy of your exploration. It is very dangerous and cruel."
Hearing this, Jiang Changsheng frowned. He did not refute Taoist Qingxu, and there was nothing wrong with making up a backer, but Taoist Qingxu's words made him think of more possibilities.
"Today I will tell you the realm of martial arts today. From low to high, they are third-rate, second-rate, first-rate, true essence, and spiritual consciousness. The realm of spiritual consciousness is called the ultimate master in the ordinary world, but this is not the case. There are higher realms above. The one I currently know about is the realm of Tongtian. Today, Your MajestyIt seems that he has no skill, but he has the destiny of the emperor. Once he uses the true dragon's energy, he can be compared with the masters of the spiritual realm. The most important thing is that there is a strong man in the Tongtian realm in the palace. That person is the real pillar of the Great Jing Dynasty. "
Taoist Priest Qingxu's tone was inscrutable, and his emotions could not be heard.
Third-rate, second-rate, first-rate, true essence, spiritual consciousness, heaven-reaching!
Jiang Changsheng's brows furrowed even more. The Ghost Eye Evil King was a master of the Spiritual Consciousness Realm. He could easily kill the Ghost Eyes Evil King before breaking through to the fourth level of Taoist Natural Skills. This meant that at that time, he was at least equivalent to the invincible strength of the Spiritual Consciousness Realm. Now it is far beyond that, and he should be able to compete with the strong men of the Tongtian Realm.
This is just his guess. He doesn't dare to bet. He can only live one life and has no chance of reincarnation, so he must be careful.
Taoist Master Qingxu spoke again: "I saved you, but I have already caused great trouble for Long Qiguan. I wanted to hide it, but you have already wanted to investigate. I can only tell you, Changsheng, you have only two ways to survive. One is to send you to the holy land in the rivers and lakes, but you still can't escape the enemy's pursuit. The other is I will protect you for another five years. Within five years, you will grow as much as possible. Later, you can use the name of Long Qiguan to win over your own connections and compete with the powerful people of that day. The existence of Long Qiguan was established by His Majesty the Emperor when he founded the country and announced it to the world. Unless Long Qiguan plots rebellion, even His Majesty is not allowed to remove Long Qiguan. "
“Dajing regards faith as the foundation of the country. From the emperor to the common people, faith is the most important thing. "
"Okay, please step back. "
Jiang Changsheng did not ask any further questions this time, bowed his hands and turned to leave.
After turning around, his face turned cold.
The great powerful man.
Jiang Changsheng had understood the implication of Taoist Priest Qingxu's words, and felt lucky and scared at the same time. Fortunately, he was not reckless when he saw Jiang Yuan.
In the quiet courtyard, Taoist Priest Qingxu stared at the old tree in front of him. The mottled autumn leaves fell slowly and landed on the haystack below, without stirring up any dust and making no sound.
"Alas, it is difficult to protect both the family and the country..."
The day after chatting with Taoist Priest Qingxu, Jiang Changsheng moved out and found a courtyard to live alone. As the second senior brother, he naturally had the qualifications. Meng Qiu Shuang, who was in charge of the power, did not even ask a question and directly agreed.
Qing Ku was reluctant to part with him, but Jiang Changsheng agreed that he would visit her at any time in the future, and the boy just smiled.
The reason why Jiang Changsheng lives alone is that he doesn't want to be disturbed and can practice his martial arts with peace of mind.
The powerful men in the Tongtian realm in the palace have become his imaginary enemies, and he must become as strong as possible.
As for the poison poisoned by Taoist Master Qingxu, he will also try to detoxify it. After all, he has mastered the Spring and Autumn Medical Code, but he cannot detoxify it for the time being. He will wait for a year or two. If there is no danger in these two years, it means that Taoist Qingxu is really good to him.
Jiang Changsheng's move did not arouse any surprise among the disciples. Instead, they thought it was natural that he should have moved out long ago.
The second senior brother lives in their courtyard, which makes them a little cramped.
After living alone, Jiang Changsheng stopped ringing the bell and handed over the responsibility to other disciples. He was now the second senior brother. Naturally, no one except Meng Qiu Shuang dared to refuse him.
A blink of an eye.
The heavy snow finally arrived, covering the capital with cold snow.
"The good and the evil gathered together in Yangshan, and they were about to engage in a world-famous battle. Unexpectedly, a man walked out of Huiyang Mountain, calling himself Emperor Yang Zhao. His skills were extremely terrifying. When both the good and the evil joined forces, he defeated them all by himself. He became famous all over the world. "
“Although we are in the arena, how can we claim to be emperor? When His Majesty learned about it, he became furious and ordered the Silver Armored Leopard and Qingqi to attack Huiyang Mountain. Three thousand Silver Armored Leopard and Qingqi were the elite of the Great Jing Dynasty. They suffered over a thousand casualties. Emperor Yang Zhao even escaped. Now Emperor Yang Zhao's bounties are hanging in every corner of the Jing Dynasty. "
Chen Li spoke solemnly, holding a wine glass in his hand, like a storyteller. Jiang Changsheng listened with great interest.
In the new year, Chen Li is aging faster than time, with more and more gray on his temples.All looking tired.
Every time he came to Longqi Temple, in addition to bringing gifts, Chen Li would talk to Yang Dai about things in the world and in the court, and sometimes he would also express his frustrations.
After Jiang Changsheng heard about the influential figures in the world, he curiously asked: "Is Your Majesty still obsessed with alchemy?"
When Chen Li heard this, he said angrily: "That's right, it's simply stupid!"
Jiang Changsheng was frightened. Although he had excellent senses and knew that there was no one outside the building, Chen Li's boldness was not a good thing and could easily lead to death. He did not want to live a homeless life.
"Don't talk nonsense, Brother Chen. You should pay more attention to your words and deeds. Maybe your predicament is related to your words and deeds."
Jiang Changsheng spoke earnestly, and Chen Li suddenly sobered up a bit, but he was still very angry.
Chen Li gritted his teeth and said: "Your Majesty attaches great importance to the Demon Dao. If the Demon Dao is close to the second prince, sooner or later there will be a danger of seizing the legitimate son. When the time comes..."
Jiang Changsheng heard it and figured out the taste.
The fake prince's position is unstable.
Could it be that Jiang Yuan meant that Yao Dao was getting close to the second prince?
Chen Li picked up the wine glass, took a sip, wiped his mouth, exhaled a long breath, and said: "Immortal, I'm leaving first. In that small box is a snake egg. This snake egg was born by a demon snake. It is very spiritual. If it can be raised well and passed on from generation to generation, it can become a mountain-protecting spiritual beast in the future."
He stood up, put on his raincoat, picked up his sword and left.
Looking at his curved back, Jiang Changsheng couldn't bear it and said, "Brother Chen, if you encounter trouble, please tell me and I will help if I can."
Chen Li stopped at the door of the room and chuckled: "You brat, when I really need your help, my Chen family will definitely be at the end of the road. I won't be stingy about opening my mouth then. Just practice hard."
He pushed the door open and closed it gently.
Jiang Changsheng was silent. It seemed that the whirlpool in the capital was getting more and more chaotic.
The emperor's obsession with pursuing immortality was a bad start in previous Chinese history, and might even lead to the collapse of the dynasty.
Da Jing Dynasty can't be the Qin Dynasty in another world!
Jiang Changsheng stood up and came to the table, lifting the cloth off the small box. It was so hot that he could even feel the faint spiritual power inside.
Descendants of monsters?
Jiang Changsheng became interested, so it would be good to raise a pet.
Judging from his current understanding, although there are monsters in this world, there are very few, at least not enough to overthrow the human dynasty. There are no immortals in this world. As for the immortal cultivators, most of them are demons and charlatans who deceive people. They are often forced out of their original form by warriors and show their ugly behavior.
